standard_prerequisites.name: The pushout cosimplicial object
standard_prerequisites.statement: The cosimplicial object U with U_n the (n+1)-fold pushout of Y over X, built from f : X to Y when the category has pushouts (the author's example-push-outs-simplicial-object, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the object of the statement (source lines 5260-5266).

standard_prerequisites.name: Retractions and the maps f s
standard_prerequisites.statement: A retraction s of f with s f = id, hence an endomorphism f s of Y appearing in each degree.
standard_prerequisites.use: It produces the self map of the statement (source lines 5261-5266).

standard_prerequisites.statement: For a morphism with a section, the degreewise self map on the fibre-product simplicial object is homotopic to the identity (the author's lemma-fibre-products-simplicial-object-w-section, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the dual statement from which this one follows (source lines 5272-5274).

standard_prerequisites.name: The comparison of homotopies
standard_prerequisites.statement: The author's comparison lemma relating homotopies of simplicial and cosimplicial objects.
standard_prerequisites.use: It transfers the dual statement to this setting (source lines 5274-5275).

core_obligations: Identify the dual statement: recognise the present claim as the dual of the fibre-product lemma for sections (source lines 5272-5273).
Transfer the conclusion: apply the comparison lemma for homotopies to obtain the homotopy, hence the homotopy equivalence with the constant cosimplicial object (source lines 5274-5275).

proof_roadmap.step: Recognise the statement as dual to the fibre-product lemma.
Apply the comparison lemma to conclude.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-push-outs-simplicial-object-w-section at source lines 5258-5269: if f : X to Y admits a retraction s with s f = id and U is the cosimplicial object built from f by iterated pushouts, then the degreewise self map given by f s on every factor is homotopic to the identity, so U is homotopy equivalent to the constant cosimplicial object X. The proof at source lines 5271-5276 is a two-sentence duality argument: the statement is dual to the fibre-product lemma for simplicial objects, and the comparison lemma carries the conclusion across. The card's content is therefore the statement (with its explicit construction) together with the observation that the proof is formal duality, and the two lemmas it names are retained as context.
